notes: «كتب إلى يعلى بن حكيم أني سمعت» is read by rule 5 (the one written to is a link, then the one heard): the letter's route is not otherwise stated, so this is the reading, not a certainty.
«رواه سعيد عن يعلى بن حكيم» names another transmitter: a variant group. «- ... -» glosses and the wording are left out.
